classification: Redis product health and snapshot CLI legacy authentication incompatibility

first_failure.reason: Product Redis CLI checked only REDISCLI_AUTH; the pinned legacy agent exposes REDIS_PASSWORD, so the six health PING requests return NOAUTH

proof: Read-only diagnostics identify REDIS_PASSWORD as the only auth environment key on all six legacy members. Product CLI prefix PING returns rc=1 and NOAUTH on all six. Independent authenticated TLS INFO proves one master, two synchronized replicas and reachable Sentinel quorum; this is a CLI authentication failure, not proof of failed replication.
fix: Health and snapshot prefer REDISCLI_AUTH, fall back to REDIS_PASSWORD when empty/missing, normalize CRLF and export to redis-cli. No credentials in argv, diagnostics or exception output.
static_regression: Exact subprocess contract first fails for both helpers with legacy-only and empty-current environments; after repair it accepts both forms and current-variable precedence. Related contracts and complete Redis static gate pass.
impact_analysis: Current 0.27 authentication precedence and CRLF behavior remain unchanged. New support covers the fixed legacy upgrade fixture; unrelated middleware and Ceph are untouched.

live_qualification.acceptance: Legacy fixture, retained seeded current business and absolute TTL, current recovery and owned cleanup; not full upgrade module
